description: This Java source file defines the ComponentLocationResolver class, which implements location resolution logic for components within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to resolve locations to URLs and to derive base locations from component identifiers.

classes.name: ComponentLocationResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves component locations to URLs, handling component-specific path logic within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a location string to a URL, converting component-relative paths into file URLs.

methods.name: getBaseLocation
methods.description: Extracts and constructs the base location path for a given component location string, handling component name extraction and root location retrieval.
